Port 6006 bound to 0.0.0.0 by default (PHOENIX_HOST default), exposed beyond localhost
gRPC OTLP collector on port 4317 open for unauthenticated trace ingestion by default
Default admin password 'admin' active if auth enabled without PHOENIX_DEFAULT_ADMIN_INITIAL_PASSWORD override
